newsitem.title: USA: Genta may be delisted from Nasdaq.
newsitem.headline: Genta may be delisted from Nasdaq.

text.p: Genta Inc said that as of September 30, it did not meet net tangible asset criteria required for listing on the NASDAQ National Market, and may face delisting of its common stock.
The company said it is seeking additional funding or collaborative agreements that may help it to meet this criteria. However, it said there are no assurances it will be able to obtain either.

At September 30, cash and cash equivalents totaled $1.7 million. If such funding is unavailable, it will deplete cash, license or sell some of its assets and technology, scale back or cut some or all of its development programs and further reduce workforce and spending.
It said that if such measures are not successfully completed, it will be forced to discontinue operations.

Further, a delisting could adversely affect the liquidity of the common stock. The company is currently in discussions to renegotiate certain terms of its agreement with holders of its Series A preferred stock.
